text:
anna: Heads-up: customer reported weird SSE output where chunks are duplicated after cellular->wifi switch. small sampleapp repro attached.

mike: ugh network change race again? did they hit auth refresh at the same time?

sam: I looked at logs — auth refresh coincides but there are also overlapping reconnects. stream framing looks like: final delimiter missing on one connection then fragments from old conn replayed by proxy when new conn comes up.

jess: can you paste the raw event stream? curious if it's a boundary-split (\r\n\r\n) issue or event:data split.

sam: snippet from the proxy capture:

```
event: message\ndata: {"id":"a1","chunk":"Hello \n"}
\n
--conn drop--
\n
event: message\ndata: {"id":"a1","chunk":"world"}
\n
```

sam: you can see the same id streamed across two connections; client SDK ends up applying both fragments because the resume logic isn't deduping by last-event-id consistently.

anna: which SDK? node or python?

sam: both. Node sampleapp applied both fragments more often under fast reconnects, python seemed to sometimes drop the second fragment (parity mismatch).

mike: that's a problem. We should ensure the client-side SSE parser de-duplicates by event id and also handle partial data (chunked JSON). SDKs must expose the same semantic: assemble fragments by id, ignore duplicates once sequence complete.

jess: there might also be a server-side guarantee we can lean on: we do send resume-token header on reconnect. but proxies in front might replay buffered bytes. so client should be defensive.

anna: propose triage steps:
1) add repro harness to sampleapp that simulates conn flip and proxy replay
2) add unit test for dedupe-by-id in node/python SDKs
3) add small change to Node parser to buffer incomplete JSON across SSE chunk boundaries

mike: agreed. I'll own node parser change + unit tests.

sam: I'll add harness and run it against our dedicated QA infra with flaky-network profile. attaching quick command to reproduce locally:

```
# run sampleapp with proxy replay enabled
python sampleapp/run.py --simulate-network-flip --proxy-replay --seed 42
```

jess: nice. any API changes needed? we should avoid breaking clients.

anna: no API changes. internal parser reliability and tests only. also update docs sampleapp troubleshooting section.

ci-bot: build queued for branch fix/sse-dedupe (job #4589)

mike: I'll open the PR after CI passes. ETA EOD PST.

sam: I'll post the reproduction artifacts here when available. thanks :thumbsup:

jess: thanks all. logging an issue in our backlog (INFR-7683) to track cross-sdk parity and add a monitoring alert for duplicate event ids per user.

anna: filing customer follow-up: will reply with repro ETA later today.
